functions.name: InitLinear
functions.signature: InitLinear(Target, Min Time, Max Time, Bin Size)
functions.docs: Fairly generic histogram for values that have natural lower bound and possibly no upper bound, e.g., frame time

functions.name: InitHitchTracking
functions.docs: Inits histogram to mimic our existing hitch buckets

functions.name: InitFromArray
functions.docs: Inits histogram with the specified bin boundaries, with the final bucket extending to infinity (e.g., passing in 0,5 creates a [0..5) bucket and a [5..infinity) bucket)

functions.name: Reset
functions.docs: Resets measurements, without resetting the configured bins.

functions.name: AddMeasurement
functions.docs: Adds an observed measurement.

functions.name: AddMeasurement
functions.signature: AddMeasurement(Target, Value For Binning, Measurement Value)
functions.docs: Adds an observed measurement (with a different thresholding key than the measurement, e.g., when accumulating time spent in a chart keyed on framerate).

functions.name: DumpToLog
functions.docs: Prints histogram contents to the log.

functions.name: DumpToJsonString
functions.docs:
Returns a string in a Json format: [{"Bin":"BinName","Count":Count,"Sum":Sum},...].
Bucket name is constructed by calling ConvertBinToLabel on the MinValue and UpperBound for each bin.
Convert function is used to allow the bin range, which is stored as a double, to be printed prettily.

functions.name: DumpToJsonString
functions.docs: Same as DumpToJsonString but uses a DefaultConvertBinToLabel.

functions.name: DumpToJsonString2
functions.docs:
Returns a string in a Json format: [{"BinName":{"Count":Count,"Sum":Sum}},...].
Bucket name is constructed by calling ConvertBinToLabel on the MinValue and UpperBound for each bin.
Convert function is used to allow the bin range, which is stored as a double, to be printed prettily.

functions.name: DumpToJsonString2
functions.docs: Same as DumpToJsonString2 but uses a DefaultConvertBinToLabel.

functions.name: DefaultConvertBinToLabel
functions.docs: Default stringifier for bins for use with DumpToJsonString. Truncates to int and uses Plus as the suffix for the last bin. ie. [0.0, 3.75, 9.8] -> 0_3, 3_9, 9_Plus

functions.name: GetNumBins
functions.docs: Gets number of bins.

functions.name: GetBinLowerBound
functions.docs: Gets lower bound of the bin, i.e. minimum value that goes into it.

functions.name: GetBinUpperBound
functions.docs: Gets upper bound of the bin, i.e. first value that does not go into it.

functions.name: GetBinObservationsCount
functions.docs: Gets number of observations in the bin.

functions.name: GetBinObservationsSum
functions.docs: Gets sum of observations in the bin.

functions.name: GetNumMeasurements
functions.docs: Returns the sum of all counts (the number of recorded measurements)

functions.name: GetSumOfAllMeasures
functions.docs: Returns the sum of all measurements

functions.name: GetAverageOfAllMeasures
functions.docs: Returns the average of all measurements (essentially a shortcut for Sum/Count).

functions.name: GetMinOfAllMeasures
functions.docs: Returns the minimum of all measurements.

functions.name: GetMaxOfAllMeasures
functions.docs: Returns the maximum of all measurements.

functions.name: FHistogramBuilder
functions.signature: FHistogramBuilder(Target, In Histogram, Starting Value, Starting Value)
functions.docs: Bins themselves, should be continous in terms of [MinValue; UpperBound) and sorted ascending by MinValue. Last bin's UpperBound doesn't matter

functions.name: AddBin
functions.docs: This will add a bin to the histogram, extending from the previous bin (or starting value) to the passed in MaxValue

functions.name: FinishBins
functions.docs: Call when done adding bins, this will create a final unbounded bin to catch values above the maximum value
